profileEvidence.summary: Affectionate and strongly attached to its own person, the long-haired Majorca Shepherd shares the breed’s reserve toward strangers. Known as the Ca Cabrer, it is an officially described coat variety of Mallorca’s Ca de Bestiar. These dogs have worked with sheep and goats as well as other farm animals, combining pastoral work with guarding; their characteristic working gait is a gallop.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: The long-haired Ca de Bestiar shares the breed’s attachment to its keeper and its history of pastoral work and guarding.
